مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
 weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

IR139 is 
a communication module for theCE2000. This module provides exchanges by MODBUS 
protocol. In this protocol, CE2000, Associated with C370 through IR139 board, 
Can only be master

Each 
module channel can be connected to oneslave 
subscriber (point to point) or to n Slaves (bus connection)

For 
IR139-1 version, the basic module has 4 RS232/RS485 channels.
Dimension:
Connections :

The serial connections 
are located on the front panel.

They are not isolated, 
so IR139 module cannot be connected to devices without a floating 0V (the module 
and/or the device could be damaged).

An isolating module is 
recommended for outside connections (metal casing).

For RS232, the line 
length is limited to 15 m.

For RS485 with 
isolating module, this length is limited to 1 km.
Controls and Indications on The Front Panel

A green 
LED remains on for normal working. It goes out in the following cases:

The 
 module access through UT129 is not detected (UT129 missing or module hardware 
 fault detected),

The module 
 detects an internal hardware fault,

The module 
 detects a user fault on a transmission line with one or several subscribers; 
 in this case, normal working is resumed only when a correct exchange with the 
 faulty subscriber(s) is detected
